entities.title: Offline reigns can't be entered
entities.summary: A reign the server issued no seed for still plays, with a seed of the browser's own, but cannot go on the table.
entities.impact: A player whose connection drops before the reign starts loses the chance to enter it; the name entry is never offered.
entities.workaround: Start another reign once the connection is back.

entities.title: A day and 20,000 keys
entities.summary: The server replays reigns of up to 20,000 keys, each key at most 12 characters, and seeds expire after 24 hours unused.
entities.impact: A longer reign, or one submitted a day after it started, is refused.

entities.title: Plain names
entities.summary: Names are up to 12 plain characters; accents are dropped and a few letters spelled out (Þór becomes Thor). The name entry types only capitals, digits, dots, hyphens and spaces.
entities.impact: Names in other scripts cannot be shown.

entities.title: The best rating is this browser's
entities.summary: The best rating shown on the welcome screen is kept in this browser's local storage only.
entities.impact: Another browser or device starts with no best; with storage blocked there is no best at all, and the game still runs.

entities.title: No saved games
entities.summary: A reign cannot be saved or resumed; closing the page ends it.
entities.impact: A reign must be played in one sitting.

entities.title: English only
entities.summary: Every string is in English, in src/ui/text.ts.
entities.impact: No translations; the text budget leaves room to add them.

entities.title: One report offer a month
entities.summary: State Security offers its file only once a month, at the month's end; the original offered it up to four times.
entities.impact: A player cannot see the plots between the dangers and the decision; the file shows the statuses as of the month's last plot check.
